title: Check yourself: The written design review: findings, verdict and scorecard

questions.stem: Scenario: A review of a pilot finds one medium finding, a missing owner, and two low findings, a small evaluation set and an unstated accuracy. There is no high finding. What does the review conclude?

options.text: Approve it, since no finding is serious enough to stop the pilot
options.says: Ruled out because "revise if none is high and any is medium", so a medium finding stops an approval.

options.text: Return it for revision, since the ladder calls for one here
options.says: With no high finding and a medium one, the review asks for a revision.

options.text: Reject it, since the findings differ in kind and several are present
options.says: Ruled out because "reject if any finding is high" and none is.

options.text: Approve it, since the two low findings outnumber the medium one
options.says: Ruled out because "A fixed ladder keeps a pile of small findings from becoming a rejection", and by the same ladder a pile of small findings cannot outweigh a medium one.

questions.stem: Scenario: A reviewer proposes to write the findings grouped by domain, P1 first, because the course is organised in that order. What is the objection?

options.text: The sponsor reads the domains in another order, so the list would confuse
options.says: Ruled out because the order is chosen for the reader of the findings, and the page says "The sponsor stops at the verdict and the scorecard".

options.text: Two reviewers would still produce different lists from the same design
options.says: Ruled out because "Two reviewers must produce the same list", and a fixed order by domain and rule id also gives the same list.

options.text: The domains do not match the rules that the review applies
options.says: Ruled out because the page says of the rules "Each is a fact about the design or a number with a threshold", and the table gives every one a domain from P1 to P7.

options.text: The blocking items would be buried among the milder ones
options.says: A list ordered only by domain hides the blocking items.
